warning.titlePre: Mercedes Vaneo 1.7 CDI Injector Seal Leaks
paragraphs: If your Vaneo 1.7 CDI has the OM668 diesel engine — fitted across the entire W414 generation from 2001 to 2005 — injector seal leaks are a well-documented pattern on this engine, shared with the early A-Class of the same era. We replace injector seals, timing chain components, and gaskets as standard on every OM668 rebuild.
